description: This Java class represents ConceptDescription entities in the OpenMRS healthcare system, including fields, constructors, getters/setters, and utility methods for managing localized descriptions of medical concepts.

classes.name: ConceptDescription
classes.description: Represents localized description of a concept, with metadata such as locale, creator, timestamps, and change history.

methods.name: getConceptDescriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier for this ConceptDescription.

methods.name: setConceptDescriptionId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this ConceptDescription.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Associates a Concept object with this description.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale indicating the language/region of the description.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for this description.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the User who created this description.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who last modified the description.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who last modified the description.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of last modification.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of last modification.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the description string for display.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key id, as required by OpenMRSObject interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key id, as required by OpenMRSObject interface.
